1374|61386298.name: Rejold Barleybrew
1374|61386298.text:
Curse that Brewers' League!  They have access to all the best ingredients, while we're stuck here grubbing for grain and hops!

I really would like to give them some bitter tasting justice...

1466|f7f23ddc.name: Gretta Finespindle
1466|f7f23ddc.text: Oh, goody, something else to do while I wait! You're a real life-saver, $N!

258113|1605f087.name: Ingrid Dunwald
258113|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

264936|6ba63b30.name: Earthseer Farsen
264936|6ba63b30.text: On a clear day, you can even see Blackrock Mountain from here. It's both beautiful and terrifying at the same time.

267336|0371bf6f.name: Brighid Stormflayer
267336|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

267687|14707f63.name: Blue Mechanostrider
267687|14707f63.text:
<The tag on the mechanostrider reads:

Electric Blue Mecha-turbo Runner 5000, now with extra movement tracking and terrain damping for a smooth ride!>

267688|ad18a6ee.name: Unpainted Mechanostrider
267688|ad18a6ee.text:
<The tag on the mechanostrider reads:

The Chromo-Classic Mechanostrider! Now with hydraulic equilibrium enhancers, and mithril tailpipe dampers.>

271546|7dbe534f.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
271546|7dbe534f.text:
Lookin' fer the courier? Just flew off like a wee bird.

Can't say I blame the poor sod. These wendigos are nasty business.

5150|942980f4.name: Nissa Firestone
5150|942980f4.text: Are you a student of the medical sciences?

8508|15b608c8.name: Gretta Ganter
8508|15b608c8.text: Lookin' to fish? Then you'll need the proper tools.

170-accept.name: Balir Frosthammer
170-accept.text:
I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.

I hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.

And that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west! 

We're a bit shorthanded here, lad, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
170-accept.title: A New Threat

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

182-progress.name: Grelin Whitebeard
182-progress.text: From what I've learned, these trolls hail from the Frostmane clan. I'm afraid I don't know much else about them that would be of any use to you, $N.
182-progress.title: The Troll Cave

2160-progress.name: Tannok Frosthammer
2160-progress.text: Hi there! Come in, take a seat by the fire and warm yourself with a flagon of ale.
2160-progress.title: Supplies to Tannok

233-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
233-accept.text:
Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, lad? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.

They're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.

What do you say?
233-accept.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

233-progress.name: Talin Keeneye
233-progress.text: Yes? Do you have something for me?
233-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-progress.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-progress.text: Is there something I can help you with?
234-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

282-progress.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-progress.text:
Hail! Have a care, $N, the tunnel to Dun Morogh is infested with troggs and is not safe for travel.

If you haven't any pressing business in Dun Morogh, I'll have to ask you to remain in Anvilmar until the tunnel is safer.
282-progress.title: Senir's Observations

291-progress.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-progress.text: Hmm... it would seem that my guards are becoming less discriminatory with petitioners. Well, what do you want? Make it quick.
291-progress.title: The Reports

310-progress.name: Unguarded Thunder Ale Barrel
310-progress.text: The date on this barrel shows that it'll soon be tapped.
310-progress.title: Bitter Rivals

313-progress.name: Pilot Stonegear
313-progress.text: Hey, $N.  Been to the Grizzled Den yet?  Those Wendigos can be fierce.
313-progress.title: The Grizzled Den

315-progress.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-progress.text: Do you have that shimmerweed?  I almost have a batch of stout ready to brew, and I want to try throwing the weed in with this mixture.
315-progress.title: The Perfect Stout

317-progress.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
317-progress.text: Preparations are going well.  How goes your hunting?
317-progress.title: Stocking Jetsteam

3361-progress.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-progress.text:
Oh goodness $N, this town is not well suited for the likes of me.  There are as many nasty creatures here as there were in Gnomeregan before the accident!

Do you have my belongings?  If you don't, then who knows what the trolls have done with them now...
3361-progress.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3364-progress.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-progress.text: Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter.  You have something for me?
3364-progress.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3365-progress.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-progress.text: I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time!  Did you remember to bring me back my mug?
3365-progress.title: Bring Back the Mug

384-progress.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-progress.text: I'm going to need six crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt, $N.
384-progress.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

400-progress.name: Beldin Steelgrill
400-progress.text:
Hm?  You look a little young to be a siege engine pilot.  But no matter...do you need something fixed?

Well take a number and get comfortable.  I'm working on a couple engines right now and won't have time for another job for at least a few days.

Or, were you here for something else...?
400-progress.title: Tools for Steelgrill

420-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-progress.text: How are you? Like to share a drink with me, perhaps? Not much else to do in the cold.
420-progress.title: Senir's Observations

5541-progress.name: Hegnar Rumbleshot
5541-progress.text: I hope you're not here for ammo, because I'm almost out!
5541-progress.title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

94373-accept.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-accept.text:
Aye, the time's come, young $c. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the $c's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself.. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path. 

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of their necklaces they wear--crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.
94373-accept.title: Call of Earth

94373-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-complete.text:
Well done, lad. Ye've proven yerself ready. Earth's the bedrock of all things. Strength, stamina, patience. It'll shield ye, but only if ye show it proper respect. Even stone can shift if slighted. Learn its ways, and ye'll grow wiser than most. Never forget the secrets it shares. 

I'll craft ye a sapta now - accept it, and ye'll walk the true path.
94373-complete.title: Call of Earth

94373-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-progress.text:
Patience, lad, is the earth's finest virtue. It's seen mountains crumble and rivers carve valleys - slow and stubborn, like a true $r. The earth calls to ye now, for trouble brews on the horizon. Return successful, and ye'll be one step closer to bein' whole. 

Others may envy yer wisdom, but that's their burden to bear.
94373-progress.title: Call of Earth

94374-accept.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94374-accept.text:
Aye, sapta's a brew forged with magic, bindin' our spirit to the elements. Only a few $c know the recipe, and it's nae for the weak-willed. Drink it, and ye will see what others can't. Hold true--it's only to be drunk in a sacred place.

Head north to the Spirit Stone, tucked at the end of a hidden path up the mountain. Drink it there... see what the earth has to show ye.
94374-accept.title: Call of Earth

94374-complete.name: Minor Manifestation of Earth
94374-complete.text:
Ah... $N... the earth welcomes you, even in this frozen land. Bound in body and spirit, you'll walk forward knowing the mountains are your strength, the plains your patience, and the world your essence.

To pass this rite, stand humbly before the earth. The other elements are not so still - they clash and roar. Learn their dual nature, even here among the snow and stone.
94374-complete.title: Call of Earth

94375-accept.name: Minor Manifestation of Earth
94375-accept.text:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.

Be patient, $N. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.
94375-accept.title: Call of Earth

94375-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94375-complete.text: Well done! Know this - totems ain't just a mark of yer place among shamans. They're tools, a focus for spells tied to stone, soil, and other elements. As ye grow wiser, more o' the mountain's power will open to ye. The trainers will know when yer ready for more. But for now, take this totem, and let the ground speak through ye.
94375-complete.title: Call of Earth

94375-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94375-progress.text: Ahh, ye've returned. If ye have the stone, it means the mountain's chosen ye true. I'll give ye the totem it promised. But if ye've come empty-handed, off with ye! The path ain't for those who forget their way.
94375-progress.title: Call of Earth

94449-accept.name: Ingrid Dunwald
94449-accept.text:
It's been long since ye were last tested, $N. Ye've shown patience, aye -- but now it's time ye learned of chaos... of destruction. Fire's call is loud, and if ye're ready to pay its price, it'll speak to ye. 

Seek out Bruegs Kindleborn, far east in the mountains. He dwells in a cave above South Gate Outpost. He'll know if ye're truly ready.
94449-accept.title: Call of Fire

94472-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94472-complete.text: Take this and remember, it is sacred.
94472-complete.title: Earth Sapta

96031-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96031-accept.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
96031-accept.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

96031-complete.name: Gretta Finespindle
96031-complete.text:
There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96031-complete.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

96047-progress.name: Thamner Pol
96047-progress.text: I can teach you once you've gained some skill with your profession.
96047-progress.title: Camping 101: First Aid

96056-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96056-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
96056-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

96628-progress.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96628-progress.title: The Adventurer

96629-progress.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
96629-progress.text: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96629-progress.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97277-progress.name: Grund Drokda
97277-progress.text: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!
97277-progress.title: Grund and Gozwin

98321-progress.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-progress.text: Wendigos are nasty beasties. Its just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece!
98321-progress.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98323-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
98323-progress.text:
Ah, you're back just in time.

What's the matter, lad? You look like you've seen a ghost.
98323-progress.title: Secure the Mountain

98326-progress.name: Gretta Ganter
98326-progress.text: It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo.
98326-progress.title: Frosthowl

98581-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
98581-accept.text: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. Based on the Wildhammer style to these inscriptions, I'm guessin' this came from the $c trainer Teo Hammerstorm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98581-accept.title: Archaic Rune

98581-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
98581-complete.text: The shamanic arts have been kept by the Wildhammer clan for years, an' now those arts have passed into the care of the Bronzebeard dwarves as well. I'm here ta help spread these teachings an' offer guidance for new shamans learning the ways of the elements. Come ta me if ya need more trainin' in the spells of earth, air, fire, an' water.
98581-complete.title: Archaic Rune

98581-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
98581-progress.text: Ah, you were able to read the rune? It is imbued with the power of elements from some of our oldest script. That shows that you have the makings of a $c.
98581-progress.title: Archaic Rune

99158-progress.name: Father Gavin
99158-progress.text: Why did the Light guide you here today?
99158-progress.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99159-progress.name: Father Gavin
99159-progress.text: Light guide you on your tasks.
99159-progress.title: Finding Warmth
